title: Make payment webhooks idempotent by event id
author: marcus-chen
body:
Fixes the duplicate invoices from INC-2026-022.

The payment provider retries any webhook delivery that is not acknowledged within 10 seconds. During the database slowdown our handler took ~14s, so invoice.upcoming events were delivered twice and both deliveries created an invoice.

Changes:
- WebhookHandler records the event id with Redis SET NX (7 day TTL) before running side effects and returns 'duplicate' for repeats.
- Invoices store source_event_id so we can audit which event created them.
- We acknowledge first and do slow work in a background job (follow-up ticket BILL-311).

comments.author: dana-whitfield
comments.body: Should the dedup key be the event id or a hash of the payload? Providers sometimes resend with a new id.

comments.author: marcus-chen
comments.body: Their docs guarantee the same event id across retries, so event id it is. A payload hash would also dedupe legitimately identical events.

comments.author: priya-raman
comments.body: 7 days TTL matches the provider's maximum retry window (3 days) with margin. LGTM.
